name: ziztu-drama-writer
description: Writes faceless YouTube channel scripts and makes the narrated video with Ziztu YouTube Studio, directs short reels and YouTube Shorts with Ziztu Reel Studio, and writes and makes micro drama series on Ziztu. A fourth skill layers AI images and video in depth and fixes flat frames.

interface.shortDescription: Make faceless YouTube videos, reels and micro dramas
interface.longDescription: Write a faceless YouTube channel script chapter by chapter and turn it into a narrated video with Ziztu YouTube Studio: plan, script, story check, price in credits, pictures to look at before motion, listing and export. Direct a short reel or YouTube Short scene by scene with Ziztu Reel Studio. Write a vertical micro drama series (pitches, a series bible, a season grid, Fountain episode scripts) and make the episodes on Ziztu. A fourth skill, Cinematic Depth, writes a soft foreground, a sharp subject and a hazy background into image and video prompts and fixes flat frames.
defaultPrompt: Use $ziztu-faceless-youtube to pick a niche and write the script for my first faceless YouTube video.
Use $ziztu-faceless-youtube to make my finished script into a video on Ziztu. Show me every price before you spend.
Use $ziztu-viral-reels to write a 30 second reel with a 1 second hook and a picture for every line.
Use $ziztu-micro-drama to pitch three micro drama series and write the bible for the best one.
